pages.name: Owen Defense: Naselwaus Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed ...g5 onto the bishop's square; plan 3 spoke of a pin on f6 (the e7-pawn blocks it); the overview missed that 3.Bg5 leaves e4 to the b7-bishop. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Rat Defense: Fuller Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 defended an e4-pawn White doesn't have; plan 3 attacked a 'central pawn duo' that isn't there. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: St. George Defence
pages.notes: Plan 4 read c5 as a move. Reworded plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: St. George Defence
pages.notes: Plan 2 gave Black an extra piece when White is ahead after Qxa8; the overview called it a bishop sacrifice for survival. Rewrote overview and plan 2 around the Qd5+ fork; British spelling.

pages.name: St. George Defence/Three Pawns Attack
pages.notes: Plan 3 read c6 as a move. Reworded plan 3 (reviewer: first draft called a6 a weak square, revised to the a6-pawn, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured ...Qxd5 before White has taken on d5. Reworded plan 1.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 castled long with the c1-bishop and b1-knight still home. Reworded plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Anderssen Counterattack
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Bxc3 with the bishop still on f8; plan 3 suggested ...c5 alongside ...e5. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Anderssen Counterattack, Orthodox Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 pressed a d4-pawn that has gone (dxe5); plan 3 was vague. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Icelandic-Palme Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured ...Bxe6 before dxe6. Rewrote plan 1 (reviewer: first draft called the d-file open, revised to half-open, re-accepted); British spelling.
